subject: Coordinating HeliosAI security review + ops stakeholders
messages:
From: Anya Petrova <anya@heliosai.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@heliosai.com>, Priya Shah <pshah@heliosai.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: security review + infra attestation (HeliosAI)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week — the HeliosAI infra team would like to run a formal security review before we move to a dedicated evaluation. We'd like to cover: data flows, network isolation options for Private deployment, KMS/HSM integrations, and any relevant SOC2 evidence.

Participants we plan to bring: myself (security lead), Tom (procurement/contract owner), and Priya (platform engineer). Can you share availability next week for a 60–90 minute session? Ideally windows that work for both your security/compliance folks and an SE deep-dive.

Also please share a short agenda and any pre-read templates so our compliance team can prepare.

Thanks,
Anya
Security Lead, HeliosAI

(Attachment: Helios_Request_Form.pdf - short stub)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Anya Petrova <anya@heliosai.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security review + infra attestation (HeliosAI)

Hi Anya — great to hear this is moving forward. Thanks for outlining the attendee list.

Proposed slots (60–90m, PT):
- Wed May 13, 11:00–12:30 PT
- Thu May 14, 09:00–10:30 PT
- Fri May 15, 13:00–14:30 PT

Diego (SE) and Marissa (security) are cc'd to confirm their availability and to flag if we should stretch to 90m. We'll send a short agenda and pre-read (inventory + SOC2 pointer) by EOD today.

Quick ask for your side: can Priya or Tom share the primary compliance contact and any baseline questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ) so we can pre-populate responses? That will save time in the session.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: — none yet)

Hi all — looping in the Redwood compliance agenda. Attached is a 1-page agenda and our environment inventory template to speed pre-work. We recommend 90 minutes for the first session: 30m architecture + dataflow, 30m controls/evidence and KMS discussion, 30m open Q&A + next steps.

Pre-reads: please upload any SIG/CAIQ or internal questionnaires to the shared Drive link. If Helios wants SOC2 excerpts, I'll include the relevant sections (non-sensitive summary).

Proposed final slot: Thu May 14, 09:00–10:30 PT — unless Helios confirms Wed and Diego can cover the first portion.

Marissa Cole
Principal Compliance Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Security & Compliance

(Attachment stubs: Helios_Security_Readout_Agenda.pdf, Redwood_Env_Inventory.xlsx)

Thanks — Thu May 14 09:00–10:30 PT works for our team. We'll upload the CAIQ and a short network diagram to the Drive folder by EOD. Tom will join for procurement/contract questions for the last 15 minutes.

Please send a calendar invite with a Webex link and the attendee list. Also, Marissa — if you can flag any specific SOC2 sections you'll reference, we can make sure our legal/compliance folks are on standby.

See you Thursday.

Best,
Anya
